Test strips were also available to ensure that lactic acid based sink and surface sanitizing solution is at a strength between 704ppm-1875ppm per manufactures instructions. More test strips were also available to ensure that quaternary ammonia sanitizing solution is at a strength of at least 200ppm for sanitizing both dishes/utensils and food contact surfaces. The following items were corrected from the previous inspection: Item #12D) The door to the staff bathroom is now self-closing. Item #15A) The ceiling in the walk-in cooler has been cleaned of dust and debris.
